IC1: Histologically [OR] or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the breast [AND] with locally advanced or metastatic disease [AND], and a candidate for chemotherapy.
IC3: [NOT] No prior chemotherapy [AND] for their metastatic breast cancer (MBC).
IC6: For women of childbearing potential [OR] and men with partners of childbearing potential, agreement to use a highly effective, non-hormonal form of contraception [OR] or 2 effective forms of non-hormonal contraception by the patient and/or partner. Contraception use must continue for the duration of study treatment and for at least 6 months after the last dose of study treatment. Male patients whose partners are pregnant [AND] should use condoms for the duration of the study.
